prompt: Which female political leader's nickname "Iron Lady" has been criticized as problematic because of her pro-European stance?
answer: Angela Merkel, Germany’s former chancellor, was sometimes called the “Iron Lady,” though the nickname was criticized as a poor fit because of her broadly pro-European stance—contrasting with Margaret Thatcher’s Euroscepticism.
